name: Ловля фігури
description:
In this lesson, there is one piece of your opponent with little space to maneuver. So little space in fact that you can trap it! With clever preparatory moves you drive the piece into a corner in order to win it afterwards. Good luck!

What what do you have to do?
Trap one of your opponent's pieces and win material.

examples.text: The black bishop can be trapped by advancing the pawns on the kingside.
